title: [bug] from_mapping type hint accepts Mapping but impl requires exact dict
description: Presence.from_mapping, PresenceCache.from_mapping, and PresenceCacheEntry.from_mapping all declare parameter type Mapping[str, Any] but _require_map uses 'type(document) is not dict' which rejects valid Mapping subclasses like OrderedDict. Type hint is misleading - should either change impl to isinstance(document, Mapping) or narrow type hint to dict[str, Any].
